metadata.modelScope: Arcascope/circadian grounds light schedules, oscillator state, phase markers, amplitude, and ESRI-style regularity. Cortisol aging is an evidence overlay, not a model output.

scenarios.label: Regular indoor day
scenarios.summary: A stable 07:00-23:00 light schedule with moderate indoor light.
scenarios.caveat: Reference educational schedule; real indoor light histories vary widely.

scenarios.label: Camping schedule
scenarios.summary: Bright daytime outdoor light with very low light at night.
scenarios.caveat: High-amplitude light-dark contrast is modeled as an illustrative outdoor schedule.

scenarios.label: Aging
scenarios.summary: Lower SCN-output strength over a regular day, with cortisol handled separately.
scenarios.caveat: The oscillator model does not simulate HPA-axis aging; cortisol uses a Van Cauter overlay.

scenarios.label: Shift work
scenarios.summary: Five night-work days followed by two day-oriented off days.
scenarios.caveat: This is a light-schedule simulation, not a personal shift-work risk estimate.

chronotypes.label: Neutral
chronotypes.summary: Near the default Forger99 intrinsic period.
